candidate_as_built.explanation: The grey-green paint is uniform and clean across all views, with sharp edges and clear hardware details visible in the detail block.

candidate_aged.explanation: The aged state shows convincing broad paint retention with irregular edge corrosion and downward rust runs, though the top surface dust appears slightly patchy in the top view.

locker_as_built.explanation: The reference locker presents a consistent, high-quality grey-green finish with well-defined panel lines and hardware.

locker_aged.explanation: The reference aged locker displays realistic weathering with heavy edge rust and paint flaking that matches the brief's requirements for a 1000-year environment.

grey-green_paint.observations: The base color is a consistent desaturated grey-green across all as-built views.

bare_hardware.observations: Handles and latches appear as distinct metallic elements in the as-built detail view.

dark_trim.observations: Dark trim is visible along the bottom edges and panel seams in the as-built state.

edge_corrosion.observations: Rust is concentrated on corners and edges in the aged state, particularly visible in the hero and detail blocks.

rust_runs.observations: Narrow vertical rust streaks are present on the vertical faces of the aged candidate and locker.

settled_dust.observations: A soft, light-colored overlay is visible on the upward-facing top surfaces in the aged top view.

no_biological_growth.observations: The textures show only mineral-based rust and dust, with no green or organic patterns.

findings: The rust texture on the aged locker's side panel in the hero view appears slightly more saturated than the candidate, though both are within acceptable range.
Dust distribution on the top view of the candidate is slightly more mottled than the reference locker's smoother dust layer.
limitations: The orthographic views limit the ability to judge the depth of the rust relief, and the small scale of the top view makes fine dust softness difficult to evaluate.

acceptance.rule: candidate aged >= locker aged in this review, numeric gates pass, all four view blocks inspected
